check: How many relays by the fuse box: four (ignition switch relay 21, radiator fan relay 38, injection master relay, fuel pump relay) or five? A fifth would be the start inhibitor relay 89 (a Bosch cube, terminals 30/51, 87, 85, 86). The 1974 drawing has it; a 1973 car may not.
Fuse lid: what does the label say for fuses 1-12, and are all twelve 8 A? What does fuse 12 feed (the drawing is unclear there; probably the spare for extra equipment)?

Rev counter (aftermarket, in place of the clock): where does it take its + feed, its signal (probably the ignition coil's terminal 1) and its earth, and does it have a light? What became of the clock's wires (blue 13 BL 1.0 feed, black 105 SV earth): taped off, or reused for the rev counter?
Door courtesy switches: which doors have one (all four?), and do the rear doors also switch the interior light on?
Seat heating: which seat(s) have it, is there a switch, and where does its black earth wire (94 SV 1.0) go?

Starter terminal 50: how many wires? The drawings show the thick yellow 84f from the ignition switch side, and two thin yellows for the injection (218 to the control unit, 231 to the cold start valve), probably through a small 2-pin connector near the starter.

Inhibitor and reversing-light switch on the front of the automatic transmission: how many wires and what colours? The 1974 drawing has green/white 195g and yellow 195h on the starter side, and white 95e/95f for the reversing lights.
